titolo: 100 Things From 1950s America We'll Never See Again
descrizione:
Here are 100 things from 1950s America we'll never see again, starting with a shoe store X-ray. These things from the 1950s include some you did yourself, like dialing KLondike or licking S&H Green Stamps into a book.

Mr. Potato Head shipped in 1952 without a potato, and the Gilbert U-238 Atomic Energy Lab came with real uranium ore. The Ford Nucleon was designed to run on a nuclear reactor, and the 1958 Edsel put gear buttons where the horn should be. Other 1950s items include Mamie Pink bathroom tile, the Horn & Hardart Automat with nickel coffee, and Burma-Shave signs along two-lane highways.

Some things from the 1950s ended because they were dangerous, like the mosquito trucks kids chased on bikes through clouds of DDT. Life in the 1950s also meant closed town pools in polio season, before 1.8 million Polio Pioneers tested the Salk vaccine in 1954.
